answer: Give every verified member a small, non-renewable quota of invitations — three per epoch — and require each invitation to carry a stake from the inviter, slashed if the invitee is later proven fake. A sybil farmer cannot mint identities freely: each fake needs a real member willing to burn one of their few ember-warm invitation slots and risk their own stake, so the gale of cheap fake accounts is choked at its source. Every fake leaves a relic of trust — a traceable path back to its voucher, who loses stake and future quota, so farming costs real social capital, not just compute.
